extensions.name: CachyOS Proton
extensions.summary: Runs Windows games in Steam, with CachyOS's own fixes and tuning.
caveats: VaporOS adds it for you and keeps it apart like every extension. Pick another Proton for a single game in that game's Steam properties.

status.text: Steam runs Windows games with it.

extensions.name: CoolerControl
extensions.summary: Fan curves for your graphics card, CPU and case fans, from a web page.
caveats: It controls fans directly. VaporOS puts them back to automatic when it stops.

settings.label: Graphics card overclocking
settings.help: Lets CoolerControl change the card's clocks and power limit. Takes a restart.

copy.install: CoolerControl runs as root to reach your fans. It starts after the next restart.
copy.remove: Your fans go back to automatic. Its fan curves stay unless you delete them.

extensions.name: TruckersMP
extensions.summary: Multiplayer for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.
caveats: Steam downloads ETS2 and ATS again as their Windows version. Profiles saved only on this PC stay with the Linux version.

confirm.title: Copy your profiles?
confirm.body: Profiles saved on this PC are copied to the Windows version. Profiles already there stay.

copy.install: Steam downloads ETS2 and ATS again as their Windows version.
copy.remove: ETS2 and ATS stay on Proton. Switch them back in their Steam properties.

extensions.name: Star Citizen
extensions.summary: The RSI Launcher, set up to install Star Citizen on a disk you pick.
caveats: Easy Anti-Cheat isn't tested on VaporOS yet.

settings.label: Install on
settings.help: A game disk with 150 GB free.

status.text: Star Citizen needs 150 GB free on a game disk.
